issues: Excessive glare or overexposure detected (bright pixel fraction=80.3%, threshold=5.0%)
Camera may be physically obstructed (edge density=0.0000, intensity std=1.62)
recommendations: Clean the camera lens and ensure it is free from smudges or condensation.
Adjust the camera focus. If using an auto-focus camera, ensure the subject is within the focus range.
Adjust the camera angle to avoid direct light sources in the field of view.
Reduce camera exposure or use a polarising filter to mitigate glare.
Reposition overhead lighting so it does not shine directly into the lens.
Inspect the camera lens for physical blockage (e.g. lens cap, tape, or debris).
Check that the camera field of view has not been accidentally covered.

obstruction.note: Penalty is only applied when status is OBSTRUCTED. UNCERTAIN results do not reduce the score.
